source_review.notes: Checked seven official or primary sources. Current Google AIP-184 defines opaque date-based identifiers, selector location/mutual exclusivity, immutability, and missing-version policy for interface-based versioning. AIP-185 documents major, channel, interface, release, and visibility strategies, parallel major support, and deprecation. AIP-181 documents stability and emergency breaks. GitHub documents date-header REST versions, additive versus breaking cadence, support windows, sunset, and exceptional interventions. RFC 9110 supports media negotiation/cache variance. GraphQL specifies client-selected fields and deprecation metadata. SemVer supports declared public APIs and major/minor/patch meaning; the chapter scopes each ecosystem policy and does not universalize it.
